title: catevala venosa
intro: Catevala venosa, commonly known as Red Clover, is a perennial flowering plant native to Europe and Western Asia. It is valued for its medicinal and nutritional properties, with potential health benefits including reducing menopausal symptoms, alleviating menstrual discomfort, and supporting cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Red Clover are attributed to its ability to act as an estrogen mimic, modulating the body's hormonal balance and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Red Clover include isoflavones, such as genistein and daidzein, as well as coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
